q: ---- than it started ringing again.
o: No sooner I did put the phone down
No sooner had I put the phone down
No sooner had I been put the phone down

q: Which of the following sentence constructions is correct?
o: Would that the weather could sunny for our picnic.
Would that the weather could be sunny for our picnic.
Would that the weather being sunny for our picnic?
Would that the weather could have been sunny for our picnic.
e: Would that বাক্যের শুরুতে বসে অবাস্তব বা অপূর্ণ ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ করে। এর গঠন: Would that + subject + could + verb-এর base form। তাই Would that the weather could be sunny শুদ্ধ। উদাহরণ: Would that I could go back in time and undo my mistakes। অন্য অপশনে be verb বাদ পড়েছে (could sunny), অথবা could have been বসে অতীত অর্থ এসেছে, কিংবা being দিয়ে ভুল গঠন হয়েছে; তাই সেগুলো ঠিক নয়।

q: He talks as if ______.
Fill in the Blank: If I _____ you, I would apologize.
Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: She laughed as though she has heard a funny joke.
She laughs as though she had heard a funny joke.
She laughed as though she had heard a funny joke.
She laughed as though she heard a funny joke.

q: He spoke as if he ______ the whole incident himself, though he had not.
e: As if বা as though-এর আগের অংশ past হলে এবং ঘটনাটি তারও আগে ঘটে থাকলে পরে Past Perfect বসে। সে কথা বলেছিল (Past Indefinite), আর ঘটনা দেখার ব্যাপারটি তার আগেই ঘটার ভান ছিল, তাই had witnessed হবে: He spoke as if he had witnessed the whole incident himself, though he had not. অর্থ: সে এমনভাবে বলছিল যেন সে নিজে পুরো ঘটনা দেখেছে, অথচ দেখেনি। Witnesses ও will witness কাল মেলায় না।

q: The office requires that we ___ our work timely.
e: Require, demand, insist, suggest, recommend এর পরে that-clause এলে Present Subjunctive ব্যবহার হয়, অর্থাৎ subject যাই হোক verb-এর base form বসে। তাই 'that we complete'। সঠিক বাক্য 'The office requires that we complete our work timely.'। অর্থ: অফিস চায় আমরা সময়মতো কাজ শেষ করি। 'have completed' ও 'completed' tense যোগ করে ফেলে, যা subjunctive-এর নিয়ম ভাঙে। 'should complete' অর্থের দিক থেকে সম্ভব হলেও বইয়ের মূল নিয়ম হলো শুধু base form।

q: If I __________ enough riches, I would have established a school for street children.
e:
মূল clause-এ would have established থাকায় if-clause-এ past perfect লাগে। এখানে main verb হলো have (থাকা, অধিকারে থাকা), তার past perfect রূপ had had, তাই If I had had enough riches শুদ্ধ।

  • Past perfect = had + V3; have-এর V3 হলো had, তাই had + had।
  • যেমন: If she had had time, she would have come.
  • Have যখন অধিকার বোঝায়, তখন Third Conditional-এ had had বসে।
  • Riches মানে সম্পদ (wealth); সমার্থক: fortune, affluence; বিপরীত: poverty।

q: Which one is correct?
o: If I had a million dollars, I would traveled the world.
If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I had travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I would have traveled the world.

q: If you cheat me, you ______ by yourself.
e:
শর্তের অংশে If you cheat me (present simple) থাকলে ফলের অংশে will + verb-এর passive রূপ will be cheated বসে; এটি First Conditional, আর এখানে কর্তা you নিজেই ফল ভোগ করবে বলে passive voice দরকার। যেমন: If you lie, you will be punished. (মিথ্যা বললে শাস্তি পাবে।)

  • First Conditional-এর গঠন: If + present simple, will + base verb।
  • Passive voice-এর গঠন: will be + past participle।
  • Cheat (প্রতারণা করা)-এর রূপ: cheat, cheated, cheated।
  • Second Conditional হলে গঠন হতো If + past simple, would + base verb।

q: If I had been Shakespeare! (Make it Assertive)
o: I wish I had been Shakespeare.
I wished I had been Shakespeare.
I wish if I had been Shakespeare.

q: No sooner had he entered the room _____.
e: No sooner-এর সঙ্গে জোড়া বাঁধে than, অন্য কোনো শব্দ নয়। গঠন: No sooner + had + subject + past participle + than + পরের অংশ। তাই No sooner had he entered the room than the lights went out শুদ্ধ। অর্থ: ঘরে পা রাখামাত্রই আলো চলে গেল। and, when বা then বসালে গঠন ভেঙে যায়। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang।

q: If you had performed well, you____ the job.
e: অতীতে যা ঘটেনি তার কাল্পনিক শর্ত বোঝাতে Third Conditional ব্যবহৃত হয়, যার গঠন: If + past perfect, subject + would have + past participle। এখানে if-clause-এ had performed (past perfect) আছে, তাই প্রধান clause-এ would have got বসবে। অর্থ দাঁড়ায়: তুমি ভালো করলে চাকরিটা পেতে, কিন্তু ভালো করোনি বলে পাওনি। will get হলো First Conditional-এর রূপ (If + present simple), would get Second Conditional-এর (If + past simple)। must get কোনো conditional গঠনের সঙ্গে এখানে মেলে না। উদাহরণ: If he had left early, he would have caught the train।

q: Had we studied harder, we ________ better grades in the exam.
e: এটি third conditional। এতে Had দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া অংশ if-এর কাজ করে এবং সেই অংশ past perfect হয়। অন্য অংশে would have, could have বা might have-এর পরে verb-এর past participle বসে। Had we studied harder ধরনের গঠনের পরে মূল অংশ হবে we would have got better grades। এতে অতীতের একটি অবাস্তব শর্তের অনুমিত ফল বোঝায়। উদাহরণ: Had she left earlier, she would have caught the train।

q: He did not go there. He _____ if I had told him.
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: If he _______ the opportunity, he _______ the competition.
e:
If-clause-এ had taken (past perfect) থাকলে main clause-এ would have + past participle বসে, তাই had taken, would have won শুদ্ধ। এটি third conditional, যা অতীতের এমন শর্ত বোঝায় যা আর বদলানো যায় না।

  • সূত্র: If + had + V3, would have + V3 (If she had studied, she would have passed.)
  • If-clause-এ সাধারণত would have বসে না; এটি একটি প্রচলিত ভুল।
  • Second conditional (If + past simple, would + verb) বর্তমান বা ভবিষ্যতের কল্পনা বোঝায়।
  • Main clause-এ would-এর বদলে could have বা might have বসালে সম্ভাবনা বা সামর্থ্য বোঝায়।

q: If he had told me the truth, I _______ him.
Find out the error. (26-30). Had I been a king, I would have help the poor.
e:
ভুল অংশটি help; third conditional-এ would have-এর পর verb-এর past participle বসে, তাই শুদ্ধ রূপ would have helped (সাহায্য করতাম)। Had I been a king, I would have helped the poor.

  • Third conditional-এর সূত্র: If + past perfect, would have + past participle; এটি অতীতের অবাস্তব শর্ত বোঝায়।
  • If বাদ দিলে Had + subject + past participle বসে: Had I been = If I had been (inversion)।
  • Modal + have-এর পর সবসময় past participle: should have gone, could have done।
  • Second conditional (বর্তমানের অবাস্তব শর্ত): If I were a king, I would help the poor।
